messages:
Mia Chen: Heads up — we need a consolidated asset pack for the benchmark launch + webinar next week. Deliverables: 1) 3 benchmark hero tiles (16:9, 1:1, story), 2) one-page benchmark diagram (svg + png + layered fig), 3) webinar hero + registration email header, 4) Figma template for inbound lead routing diagram. Brand compliance sweep required. Need by Tue EOD PT. Who can pick this up?

Alex Rivera: I can take the tiles + diagram. Quick Qs: do we have finalized hero headlines? Also what export specs for the diagram — svg + 2x png ok?

Sam Patel: Draft headlines: A) "Serve more for less" B) "Latency wins: steady inference at scale" C) "Predictable inference economics with Redwood Dedicated". Recommend A/B test A vs B on social. Email header CTA: "Save your seat". Webinar title: "Benchmarking inference economics".

Jordan Lee: For inbound: use existing Marketo form? We want UTM params: utm_source=bench_launch utm_campaign=bench_webinar. Registration should funnel to nurture path "bench_webinar_7day". Lead routing diagram should be super simple: form -> SDR queue -> AE. Any required fields for routing?

Alex Rivera: Perfect. For diagram export I'll do:
```
svg: optimized
png: 2400px width (2x)
jpg: 1200px width (for some socials)
```
Also confirming file formats: layered Figma file + flattened exports. Will include a version with editable chart layers.

Em Rivera: :white_check_mark: Brand guardrails — use primary accent token `--redwood-600` for CTAs, alt palette indigo/teal for chart series, maintain 3:1 contrast for small labels, logo full lockup on hero only. No decorative gradients on benchmark diagram. I'll do a brand sweep pre-handoff and flag any noncompliant assets.

figma-bot: New file created: <https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/benchmark-assets|Benchmark - assets> — @Alex Rivera assigned, @Em Rivera reviewer.

Mia Chen: Awesome. Alex, can you post initial drafts by Mon noon PT? Jordan/Sam let's sync on copy + UTM mapping Mon 11am PT. If Em flags anything during brand sweep, please list fixes as comments in the figma file.

Sam Patel: I'll prep two ad copy variants for the A/B test and one long-form paragraph for the webinar landing page.

Jordan Lee: Adding calendar invite for Mon 11am and tagging ops: marketing, growth, web. Will attach sample Marketo flow.

Alex Rivera: Sounds good — starting files now. Will upload first pass into the Figma file and ping here when ready. cc @design-ops for export pipeline and handoff notes"
